answer: A gateway serving ocean models, lotus scans and vertex transforms can meter subsidies by certified device ID. Require each request to sign a fresh nonce inside a secure module whose key cannot be exported. Keep the daily usage counter at the gateway, indexed by that ID, so resets and new agent keys share the same limit. A farmer needs additional certified modules and must pay their purchase or rental costs. Keep each daily subsidy below the rental cost of another module. This depends on honest certification and resistance to key cloning.
